name: Whitethorn
oneLiner: A small-animal practice on Whitethorn Green — the recovery measured, and the walk shown rather than claimed.
paletteSeed: oat paper, a soft meadow-wash band and sloe ink (a blue-green black, never pure black), with ONE accent — haw red, the hawthorn berry — reserved for live instrument readings and nothing decorative; the name section shows the berry the red is borrowed from
typeDirection: Petrona (variable serif, warm and bookish at display scale) + Familjen Grotesk (humanist grotesk body) + DM Mono (instrument readings only) — all OFL, vendored, all portfolio-new
motionBudget: one scroll clock and no second animation system: a kinematic gait study pins while its six chapters scroll past and drive it — the dog's lameness, gait, paw-trajectory loops, footfall trail and readouts all run off the same clock; the belt and trail move at the speed the dog would be travelling; reduced-motion freezes the walk and no-JS keeps every chapter's numbers in the markup; THE WINK lands at Day 84 only — the paw-prints wander up off the measured line under a note reading '(stopped to sniff something)', and the instrument then hands off to a photograph THAT MOVES: the same scroll scrubs 61 stills derived from one generated Seedance take (no timer, no autoplay, no second rAF loop — ONE clock read twice, so the added motion spends the existing budget rather than breaking it), the frames ship absolutely stacked with exactly one lit so no-JS shows a complete photograph, and reduced-motion holds that frame and never scrubs

verdict.note: 'gogogo design is approved' (s105 boot) — approved after the s104 fix round that added the warmth, the open air and the restored wink. First site of the landing arc (docs/landing-arc/spec.md), and the first built under the founder's s103 amendment restoring the claude-design mock in front of the pre-plan. Banked lessons: a code-drawn instrument may be SCHEMATIC but never a drawing of a THING; a change of REGISTER drops the requirements that belonged to the old one. | s108: the Day-84 handoff now MOVES, per his s105 direction ("can you also apply that motion to the site A and site C too?") — a 5s Seedance take grown from the already-approved Day-84 still as its single opening frame, deliberately an even trot rather than a bounding run so the picture cannot out-claim the instrument's 0/5 lameness. THE DESIGN VERDICT ABOVE IS HIS AND STANDS; the moving band is the one part of this page he has not yet seen.
